messages:
nina_cs: Noticed a trio of onboarding notes today where customers couldn't find per-route cost estimates and one expects an invoice preview. Two trial accounts flagged as renewal-risk. We need a tiny capture flow so CSMs can file these quickly.

frank_enablement: Yep — on enablement calls I've been stopping to explain console wording. A one-click Slack modal would be ideal. It should let us mark whether it's UI copy, missing data, or docs gap.

ashley_product: Minimal fields to ship: org + contact, account age, where seen (console/docs/API), symptom (one line), expected behaviour, frequency, suggested severity, attachments. If we see repeated language across captures, escalate to UX.

reno_eng: For diagnostics add optional fields: route name, deployment type (Hosted/Dedicated), sample request id. If account id is provided I can attach a small debug bundle. I can wire a webhook to create tracker issues from the modal payload.

nina_cs: Draft modal text: ```Problem: one-line
Customer: org + contact
Account age: days
Seen in: console/docs/API
Observed: short bullet
Expected: short bullet
Frequency: once/occasional/every session
Route/deployment (opt): 
Attach: screenshot/link
Suggested priority: low/med/high```

frank_enablement: That fits our flow. I'll brief CSMs to use it during tomorrow's calls and tag captures with `onboard-ux` in tracker.

capture_bot: Capture filed: CAP-2026-999 "Per-route cost not visible" submitted by frank_enablement. Link: https://tracker.internal/CAP-2026-999

ashley_product: I'll carve a 15min triage slot this afternoon. If we collect 3+ captures with similar phrasing in 7 days we bump to a UX spike.

reno_eng: Building the Slack shortcut + webhook tonight. @nina_cs please DM a test account id so I can validate the diagnostic payload.

nina_cs: Sent test id in DM. Thanks everyone ":thumbsup:" — aiming to have the modal live by tomorrow morning so enablement can use it in calls.
